resources.string:
1. Click "Open Schematic File" to select any .litematic file via the System Storage Access Framework (SAF).
2. Click "Import Pack" to select a custom .zip resource pack.
3. In 3D preview, use gestures to rotate, pan, and zoom. Use controls to switch camera modes, reset view, or select rendering sub-regions.
4. Slide the bottom panel up/down to inspect detailed block statistics.

Lodestone Schematic Viewer

Built on top of the powerful @mattzh72/lodestone 3D Minecraft structure rendering engine and aligned with Shulkr.com architecture. Providing offline 3D visualization and preview for large schematic files.

Version: 1.0.0 (Release)
Theme: Solarized Dark
